entry.hypothesis: Names where >= 2 distinct officers/directors bought within 63 sessions beat the basket by more than names with a lone buyer (PREREG H2).
entry.rationale: Independent insiders agreeing is stronger evidence than one insider's possibly liquidity-driven trade (Alldredge & Blank 2019).

stopped_names.rule: D07: a holding is sold at the close of its last stored print; no open is fabricated
